units.title: Actual projected differential gradient
units.classification: Shared sphere-calculus support interface; definitions are not theorem credit
units.statement: Write \(E_n=\mathbb R^{n+1}\), \(S_n=\{x\in E_n:\|x\|=1\}\), and \(M_{n,N}=S_n^{\operatorname{Fin}N}\). The dimensions are natural numbers and may be zero. For every natural \(n\), every function \(h:S_n\to\mathbb R\), and every \(x\in S_n\), take the total Fréchet derivative of \(h^{\mathrm r}:E_n\to\mathbb R\), its real Euclidean Riesz representative, and the orthogonal projection to \(x^\perp\). Here the total derivative agrees with the ordinary derivative where it exists and is zero where no Fréchet derivative exists. The definition asserts no regularity of \(h\). Its interpretation as the ordinary intrinsic gradient is asserted only under intrinsic C¹ regularity. Here \(h^{\mathrm r}(z)=h(\|z\|^{-1}z)\) for \(z\ne0\) and \(h^{\mathrm r}(0)=0\); \(\mathcal R^{-1}\) is the inverse real Euclidean Riesz isometry. Intrinsic C¹ refers to the ordinary stereographic smooth structure on \(S_n\).
assumptions: Use the indicated canonical real Euclidean, unit-sphere and finite-product carriers; no positive-dimension restriction is imposed.
This is a definition or abbreviation. It imposes no unstated regularity, tangency, integrability or probability hypothesis.

noncomputable def sphereTangentGradient {n : ℕ}
    (f : SpherePoint n → ℝ) (x : SpherePoint n) : SphereAmbient n :=
  ((Submodule.span ℝ ({(x : SphereAmbient n)} : Set (SphereAmbient n)))ᗮ).starProjection
    (gradient (sphereRadialExtension f) (x : SphereAmbient n))
